name: Semantic ground truth v1 - 10 Refero sites + 6 stress sites. Agent-labeled from 1280x800 captures on 2026-09-09, then human-reviewed picture by picture on 2026-09-11.
labelingMethod: Two independent labelers per site (visual-first and evidence-first) from viewport.png, fullpage.png and probe.json; a reconciler resolved disagreements or set the disputed field to null. Refero annotations were available as context, never as truth.

humanReview.reviewer: Devin Wiggins (human, picture-based review of the 2026-09-10 captures)
humanReview.method: Each site was shown as a set of pictures cut from the live capture (text in each font family, buttons, cards, text fields, the largest images) with a plain-language question per picture. The agent tags were visible as captions but the answer came from the picture.

derivation.fonts: brand -> accepted; not-brand -> rejected. Can't tell keeps the agent tag and lists the font in unverifiedFields; a font with no agent tag that the human could not judge is in neither list. A font with no visible text sample in the capture was judged by its name, so its answer stands but is also listed in unverifiedFields.
derivation.byRole: square/rounded/pill -> that value. Mixed has no byRole vocabulary: the role is null (unscored) and global is mixed. Can't tell, or a role with no crop on the page, keeps the agent tag as unverified. Avatars were not asked, so avatar tags are always unverified.
derivation.global: From the human-judged control roles only (button, card, input): any mixed -> mixed; all agreeing -> that value; disagreeing -> mixed; none judged -> agent tag, unverified.
derivation.mediaTopTwo: Each labeled crop votes with its visible area; labels are summed and the top two kept. Can't tell crops do not vote.

humanReview.unverifiedFields: Per site, the fields no picture confirmed: an agent tag the human did not judge, or a font the human judged by its name because the capture showed no text in it. A verified-only score nulls these.
